cleaning_rules: REJECT the entry whole if it contains any character outside the Vietnamese letter set; characters are never deleted from inside an entry
collapse whitespace runs to a single space and strip
drop empty entries, drop duplicates, sort ascending
window_note: max_syllables in this file is the longest entry in the dictionary and is the default sliding window bound used by engine.tokenizer.max_matching

source.name: Viet74K

license_evidence.note: The LICENSE file is vendored next to the data snapshot, so the grant travels with the data.

why_this_source: The dictionary named in the project plan (roy-a/Roy_VnTokenizer) carries no LICENSE file and the GitHub API reports license=null, so its word list cannot be redistributed.
Viet74K is a real, widely reused Vietnamese word list with an explicit GPL-2.0 grant and multi-syllable entries, which is what a Maximum Matching tokenizer needs.
It is pinned to one commit and the snapshot SHA256 is verified on every build, so the dictionary is reproducible and fully offline.
source.offline_use: engine.tokenizer loads resources/dict.txt; no network access at runtime.
